content.text: Single continuous cinematic camera move, no cuts. Stylised painterly 3D illustration with the graphic language of a hand-painted game world - bold silhouettes, simplified sculpted forms, soft painterly surfaces without fine photoreal texture detail, and light modelled in clear shapes rather than flat even illumination. Never photorealistic and never live-action, but equally never comic or cartoon. Deep violet and midnight-blue base, structures and light in royal and electric violet. Warm orange for sunset light, backlight and rim light, never as a colour of the network. No text, letters, logos, icons or symbols of any kind ever appear anywhere. The image begins on the dragonfly at the centre of a blaze of violet network light. That brilliant light at the centre swells and expands outward, racing across the whole frame, growing wider and brighter and whiter, until for a moment the entire image is pure brilliant white and everything has dissolved into light. Out of that white the sky slowly forms: tall bright clouds lit warmly from behind by a low sun, violet in their shadows and orange along their edges. The dragonfly comes forward out of the clouds towards the camera and then turns away from it, so that she is seen from behind, leading the shot. She is a precision-engineered machine of dark chrome and anodised violet with large faceted eyes and two pairs of long transparent wings veined with glowing violet nodes - elegant, constructed, never cute or cartoonish. Her wings beat hard and fast in powerful soft-blurred strokes and her luminous violet trail streams continuously behind her and never switches off. She flies out over a wide city seen from high above at sunset. The whole city is already completely networked from the first moment it appears: fine violet light lines and glowing nodes run along every street, over every roof, across every building and out through the parks and the green land at the edges, reaching all the way to the horizon in every direction. This network is finished and complete, calm and steady - it is not being created now, it is simply there, and it stays fully lit for the whole shot without ever fading, dimming or going dark. Nothing is built or added: the city, its houses and its streets were already there, and only the light lies over them. The city below is rendered in simplified sculpted forms and broad painterly shapes, never fine photoreal architecture. The camera follows the dragonfly, which leads the shot and stays visible throughout, and never loses her. The shot ends with the dragonfly clearly in frame ahead of the camera, seen from behind, both settling into a slow steady forward drift high above the glowing networked city, her violet trail streaming behind her, the sunset horizon far ahead.
